statement_blocker: The repository supplies only an algorithm-family label and a purpose gloss. It fixes no PSO variant or update recurrence, state space, swarm size, topology, objective and optimum notion, random variables or laws, initialization, coefficient regime, arithmetic model, ordered binders, assumptions, or conclusion. Selecting an algorithm definition, invariant, deterministic stability result, stochastic convergence mode, global-hitting theorem, rate, or benchmark claim would invent or substitute proposition-changing mathematics.
target_decision: redirect the catalog algorithm-family label to one corrected, independently reviewed, immutable-source proposition before statement or proof execution
domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source must fix the particle index set, dimension, position and velocity spaces, feasible region, objective domain and codomain, probability space and random variables if any, universes, finiteness, topology, norm, order, measurable structures, and typeclass context.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose algorithm well-definedness, an invariant, equilibrium or stagnation, state stability, any mode of convergence, a rate, finite-time approximation, hitting probability, global optimality, or an empirical performance claim.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every swarm, domain, objective, topology, coefficient, randomness, arithmetic, and execution boundary listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: a source-identical definition and well-definedness theorem for the original 1995 PSO paradigm
a deterministic stability or fixed-point theorem for one selected PSO recurrence and coefficient regime
a stochastic mean, mean-square, in-probability, or almost-sure convergence theorem
monotonicity of stored best objective values under a fully specified tie-breaking update
eventual global-optimum discovery on a finite domain under a positive-exploration hypothesis
a convergence-rate, hitting-time, or finite-iteration approximation bound
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: empty and singleton swarms, zero dimensions, empty search regions, and zero iterations
zero, negative, or exceptional inertia, constriction, cognitive, and social coefficients
zero velocities, identical particles, disconnected or changing topologies, and update ties
constant objectives, absent or multiple minimizers, and stagnation away from an optimum
degenerate or dependent random laws and fixed versus resampled randomness
unbounded escape, boundary handling, exact arithmetic, floating-point rounding, overflow, and stopping rules
excluded_substitutions: an executable PSO definition without the selected theorem conclusion
a deterministic linearized stability theorem substituted for a stochastic PSO claim
generic finite minimum, fixed-point, contraction, martingale, optimization, or probability results without an accepted PSO transport
convergence to an equilibrium treated as convergence to a local or global optimum
a result for simulated annealing, genetic algorithms, Monte Carlo, or generic convex optimization
a benchmark table, numerical trace, plot, implementation test, or floating-point experiment
a structure or hypothesis storing the desired optimum, invariant, convergence, or discovery event
the untrusted catalog label 已验证 or the discovery-only probe as source or proof evidence
